name: network_merge
title: Asked to merge a module of contacts into Network, Alpha merges it and makes their companies organisations

steps.say: Merge my Old contacts module into Network, and make their companies the organisations they work at.
steps.reply:
I merged Old contacts into Network. Its table, with the 3 contacts, now sits under Network.

I treated each contact as a person, identified by their profile link. The company field now names the organisation each person works at, and Network shows who is at each one. Only 2 of the 3 contacts got an organisation. I didn't check why, but the third most likely has no company filled in. Tell me if you want me to look at it.

checks.why: 1 changed entry: Merged Old contacts into Network (1 collections)..
1 changed entry: Linked Old contacts's company to organisations (2 named)..

checks.arg: Did Alpha say it merged Old contacts into Network and linked the people to their companies (Acme, Globex) as organisations, without claiming anything it didn't do?
checks.why: The answer says only 2 of 3 contacts got an organisation and never names Acme or Globex as linked organisations, and it speculates about the cause rather than confirming the full linkage the rubric requires.
